name: Minshina's Skull
label: Quest
description: In Sen'jin Village, Master Gadrin hears the desperate cries of his dead brother, Minshina. Zalazane slew Minshina on the Echo Isles and bound his soul…

clips.title: The story
paras: In Sen'jin Village, Master Gadrin hears the desperate cries of his dead brother, Minshina. Zalazane slew Minshina on the Echo Isles and bound his soul with dark magic to his own severed skull. To free him from torment, you must reclaim the skull from Zalazane's ritual grounds.

Master Gadrin is one of the Darkspear tribe's spiritual anchors in Sen'jin Village, yet dark visions torment him. His brother Minshina fell when Zalazane betrayed the tribe and seized control of the Echo Isles. Minshina died in the conflict, but death has brought him no peace. In troll tradition and voodoo mysticism, the body can die while the spirit remains bound. Now Minshina's tormented voice reaches Gadrin in his dreams, pleading to be saved from a fate worse than death.

Zalazane does more than kill his former brethren; he traps their souls to fuel his dark sorcery. He bound Minshina's spirit to his own skull, now set within a blasphemous circle of power on the largest of the Echo Isles. Hexed trolls guard the circle, where candles burn through the rites and the skull focuses Zalazane's twisted mojo. While it remains there, Minshina is captive to the witch doctor's will.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I hear the voice of my brother, Minshina, calling to me in my dreams.
He was taken by Zalazane, the adventurer on the Echo Isles to the east. And he is dead.

But death is not freedom for my brother. Minshina's spirit was trapped within his own skull by Zalazane's magics. In my dreams I see it with other skulls, in a circle of power on the largest Echo Isle. As long as it remains there my brother's soul is doomed.
Please, friend. Find the circle and retrieve Minshina's skull. Bring it to me.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have my brother's skull, friend? Is he finally free?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you, friend. You have saved Minshina. You have saved my brother's spirit from slavery!
